facts.fact: 米奇的红色皮卡在午夜过后驶进汽车旅馆的停车场。
facts.anchor: THE red pickup pulled into the motel lot well after midnight.

facts.fact: 两人已连开数小时车，路上没有出任何岔子，米奇反倒开始怀疑自己是不是白折腾了。
facts.anchor: They’d been on the road for several hours, without a single sign of trouble

facts.fact: 米奇写过程序，从上万个轮换账户里刮走不足一美分的零头；他们不缺钱，但钱本身是危险信号。
facts.anchor: Mitch had written programs that skimmed fractions of cents from a thousand rotating accounts

facts.fact: 米奇只要住一晚，却订了两间并排的房间。
facts.anchor: “Two,” he said. “If you can put them side by side.”

facts.fact: 米奇的手表每六小时响一次，提醒他吃那种药片。
facts.anchor: his watch chimed its six-hour warning

facts.fact: 他对悉尼谎称药片是治高血压的，她听了脸发白。
facts.anchor: he’d made the mistake of saying they were for “hypertension,”

facts.fact: 他把从门边顺来的宣传册递给悉尼，说远处那片黑影是废弃的游乐园。
facts.anchor: “Old amusement park,” he said, handing her the pamphlet he’d swiped from beside the door.

facts.fact: 悉尼挑了 12 号房，米奇因此拿到 13 号，他把这当成坏运气又搁开了。
facts.anchor: Sydney had chosen number 12, which meant he got 13.
